lines: Women's matches are switched off (the owner, 28 Oct 2026): this reading leaves out the 142 women's predictions of earlier sheets (85 matches). The ledger file keeps them; config.BET_TOURS switches them back on.
24 bet sheets (Sun 11 Oct 11:25 to Thu 29 Oct 06:59) made 219 predictions of 113 matches, 53 of them picks. Each match is read on its last sheet before the start, the one a bet most likely came from.

Closing price found for 61 matches: 13 true closes from Pinnacle's own listing (read within 15 minutes of its pre-match market shutting) and 48 from TennisExplorer's record of Pinnacle, the close the model's training data uses, where it is known to hold within 2 hours of the start (a median 40 minutes before it).

No close yet: 8 not started, 6 waiting for the next daily download, 31 with only an earlier price (ours, or TennisExplorer's record ending earlier), a median 6.8 hours before the start: left out below; 0 with no price at all; 7 void (a walkover, or the pairing changed before the match). 16 of the last two kinds are qualifying matches: TennisExplorer has no qualifying pages, so only Pinnacle's own listing read near the start gives their close.

Closing-line value of the 28 picks with a close (the odds taken against the closing odds, both with Pinnacle's margin; higher is better): +0.8% [-0.9%, +2.5%], n = 28: unresolved, P(above 0) 0.82. The line moved toward the pick by +0.56 points [-0.30, +1.41], n = 28: unresolved, P(above 0) 0.90.

Their expected profit if the closing price, margin removed, is the true chance: -1.9% [-3.6%, -0.3%], n = 28: below 0. A bet at the closing price itself scores -2.7% by this measure (Pinnacle's margin), so the picks are judged against that, not against 0.

Did the line move toward the model? Across the matches with a close, the market closed -0.07 [-0.25, +0.11] of the model's disagreement with the sheet's price (n = 61; 0 = not at all, 1 = all the way; the backtest found +0.01 [-0.02, +0.04]).
At the closing price the model, re-read off its curve there, still gave 27 of 28 picks a positive expected profit.

Graded matches: the model at the sheet's price against the closing price, log loss -8.0 mLL [-26.9, +10.8], n = 61: unresolved, P(above 0) 0.20 (above 0: the model was better); against the price it was fed, -4.7 mLL [-20.8, +11.4], n = 61: unresolved, P(above 0) 0.28. A few hundred matches resolve little.

This checks the prices we got, not the model: the market does not move toward this model before the close, so the model's alarm is the strength of its lean (production-integrity plan, principle 8). These are the sheets' picks at the sheet's price, not the bets placed: nothing records those yet.

Checks: TennisExplorer's record of Pinnacle at each sheet's quote time equals the sheet's own price on 175 of 204 readings (0 with the sides swapped); the run's curve re-read at the sheet's price is within 0.10 points of the sheet's chance.
